text.name: Hansel
text.ability: Each night, choose another player. If an abandonment, poison, or death ability targets them, learn the faction of one source.
text.summary: Tracks hostile abilities with moonlit pebbles.
text.flavor: White stones shine in the moonlight and show the way home.

wiki.firstNight: Hansel chooses another player and marks them with a White Pebble.
wiki.otherNight: Hansel chooses another player and receives any pending source-faction information at dawn.
notes: The Storyteller chooses one source if several observed abilities target the marked player.

text.name: Gretel
text.ability: Once per game, publicly accuse a player of being the Oven Witch. If correct, they die; if wrong, you die.
text.summary: A lethal public accusation with a fatal miss.
text.flavor: I do not know how to get in; show me how.

presentation.label: Gretel accuses
presentation.title: Gretel
presentation.description: Publicly choose the player you believe has the Oven Witch trait and record the outcome.

text.name: The Woodcutter
text.ability: Each night, protect a player from abandonment and feeding. On the first day, you cannot speak or vote.
text.summary: Protects one player, but guilt silences him on day one.
text.flavor: He loves his children, yet yields to cruelty.

wiki.firstNight: The Woodcutter chooses a player to protect.
wiki.otherNight: The Woodcutter chooses a player to protect.

effects.instruction: Resuelve manualmente esta protección cuando se intente abandonar o cebar al objetivo.
effects.reason: Abandono y cebado no son todavía eventos tipados.

text.name: The Starving Mother
text.ability: Each night, abandon a player other than last night's target. They lose their ability, speech, and vote through the following day.
text.summary: Temporarily removes a player from the social and mechanical game.
text.flavor: How can I bear the burden of leaving my children in the forest?

wiki.firstNight: The Starving Mother chooses a player to abandon.
wiki.otherNight: She chooses a player other than last night's target.

text.name: The Oven Witch
text.ability: Each night, feed two players. A protected target gains no new mark. A player dies when receiving their third Feeding mark.
text.summary: Builds fatal pressure over three nights.
text.flavor: Nibble, nibble, little mouse—who is nibbling at my house?

wiki.firstNight: The Oven Witch chooses two players to feed.
wiki.otherNight: Choose two players, advance their Feeding marks, and resolve any threshold deaths.

text.name: The White Bird
text.ability: Each night, learn a player's faction. You win personally if you survive after guiding at least one Village and one Forest player.
text.summary: Connects two factions to earn a personal victory.
text.flavor: A snow-white bird sings to guide the lost.

wiki.firstNight: The White Bird chooses a player and learns their faction.
wiki.otherNight: The White Bird chooses a player and learns their faction.

effects.instruction: Comprueba manualmente que el Pájaro Blanco siga vivo y haya observado personajes de ambos equipos requeridos.
effects.reason: La atribución histórica de observaciones aún requiere decisión del Narrador.

text.name: The River Duck
text.ability: Once per game, prevent a voted execution. The saved player is exiled and cannot speak or vote until the next dawn.
text.summary: Trades an execution death for temporary exile.
text.flavor: The white duck carries the children across the river.

presentation.label: The Duck rescues
presentation.title: The River Duck
presentation.description: When a voted execution is about to resolve, choose its candidate and prevent their death.

text.name: The Rooftop Cat
text.ability: Once per game at night, choose two players. Targeted abilities aimed at either affect the other. You win personally if you survive.
text.summary: Swaps every targeted ability between two players for one night.
text.flavor: Hansel pretends to watch the cat while dropping pebbles.

wiki.firstNight: The Cat may choose two players to swap.
wiki.otherNight: If unused, the Cat may choose two players to swap.

effects.reason: El Gato del Tejado sobrevive al final de la partida.

text.name: The Forest Hunter
text.ability: Each night, mark a player. If they are nominated the next day, you may kill them immediately. Win personally after killing a Forest and a Court player.
text.summary: Turns tomorrow's nomination into a public ambush.
text.flavor: A solitary hunter has learned to kill to survive.

wiki.firstNight: The Hunter marks a player as quarry.
wiki.otherNight: The Hunter marks a player as quarry.

presentation.description: {characterName}: {playerName} was nominated and may die immediately.

effects.reason: El Cazador del Bosque mató al menos un personaje de cada equipo requerido.

text.name: The Crossroads Crone
text.ability: Each night, protect a player from abandonment. You cannot choose the same player two nights in a row.
text.summary: Her provisions keep one traveller from being abandoned.
text.flavor: She shares the little bread left with travellers.

wiki.firstNight: The Crone gives one player a Provision.
wiki.otherNight: She gives a Provision to someone other than last night's target.

effects.instruction: Resuelve manualmente esta protección cuando se intente abandonar o cebar al objetivo.
effects.reason: Abandono y cebado no son todavía eventos tipados.

text.name: The Fire Spirit
text.ability: Each night, mark a player with fire; their second mark kills them. If a character with the Oven Witch trait dies, you die.
text.summary: Burns victims quickly and shares the Witch's fate.
text.flavor: The oven's flame feeds the Witch and consumes her victims.

wiki.firstNight: The Fire Spirit marks a player with Fire.
wiki.otherNight: Advance one player's Fire mark and resolve any threshold death.

text.name: The Bird Shepherd
text.ability: Each night, choose two players and learn whether they belong to the same faction.
text.summary: Compares the factions of two players.
text.flavor: The forest birds ate the crumbs and erased the path home.

wiki.firstNight: The Shepherd chooses two players and learns Same or Different.
wiki.otherNight: The Shepherd chooses two players and learns Same or Different.

presentation.title: Do they belong to the same faction?

text.name: The Midwife
text.ability: Once per game, declare a player innocent. If they are Village, protect them from execution and abandonment; otherwise, you die.
text.summary: A public faction test that grants strong protection or kills its source.
text.flavor: A court hand who still helps starving families.

presentation.label: The Midwife declares
presentation.title: The Midwife
presentation.description: Publicly choose a player and record whether they belong to the Village.

effects.instruction: Aplica manualmente la protección frente al abandono.
effects.reason: El abandono no es aún un evento tipado.

talepack.name: Brothers Grimm
talepack.description: Playable tales inspired by the stories collected by Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm.

text.name: Hansel and Gretel
text.tagline: Pebbles, hunger, and a burning oven: find the way home before the forest devours you.
text.description: A playable adaptation of Hansel and Gretel with Village, Court, Forest, and Cursed factions.

nightInstructions.opening: Make sure every player has closed their eyes. Resolve target swaps before other targeted abilities.
nightInstructions.dawn: Wake the village, announce deaths, and deliver any tracked-target information.

gameEndRules.reason: Todos los personajes oscuros han sido eliminados y queda al menos un personaje bueno vivo.
No queda ningún personaje bueno vivo.

popularity.note: Snapshot of the public role vote ordering, from most liked to least liked. The endpoint exposes ordering, not aggregate vote counts.
